messages.subject: Basic equating of GRM pre- and posttest
parts:
Hi there,

I'm having trouble understanding the multiplegroup function. In my study I had around n=100 students going through a pretest and intervention and a posttest. But pretest and posttest were not identical. pretest consists of 5 items, posttest of 7 items, two of them are common items. all items are polytomous with different number of levels. How do I set up a multiplegroup function to get this situation, and in the end, get the correct factor scores for pre and posttest for each student?

I've been crawling through literature for 2 days now without finding a good and clear example of how to do this, although in this group I found many hints, that it should be quite easy with the mirt package and multigroup.

I would be really glad to have a generic example for my (I think rather common) case. Thanks a lot to everybody who can support me!

Kindly, Martin
